import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const Success = () => { const { user } = useAuth(); const location = useLocation(); const [orderData, setOrderData] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { // Retrieve order details passed from the Cart checkout if (location.state?.order) { setOrderData(location.state.order); } }, [location]); return (
{/* Success Banner */}
check_circle

Thank you for your order!

Order #{orderData?.id || "LC-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}

A confirmation email has been sent to {user?.email}

{/* Left Column: Order Details */}

Order Details

{(orderData?.items || []).map((item, idx) => (

{item.name}

Size: {item.size} • Qty: {item.quantity}

₹{item.price.toLocaleString()}
))} {(!orderData?.items || orderData.items.length === 0) && (

Detailed item breakdown will be available in your profile shortly.

)}
{/* Information Grid */}

Shipping Destination

{orderData?.shippingInfo ? `${orderData.shippingInfo.firstName} ${orderData.shippingInfo.lastName}` : user?.displayName}

{orderData?.shippingInfo ? (

{orderData.shippingInfo.addressLine1}

{orderData.shippingInfo.city}, {orderData.shippingInfo.pincode}

Awaiting Dispatch

) : (

Address details available in confirmation email.

)}

Luxury Delivery Service

Method

Express Insured Air

local_shipping Est: 3-5 Business Days

{/* Right Column: Summary */}

Summary

Paid Amount ₹{(orderData?.amount || 0).toLocaleString()}
Shipping FREE
); }; export default Success;
